title: Detecting Harmful Online Conversational Content towards LGBTQIA+ Individuals

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Adapting the 'queerness' dimension from the REDDITBIAS dataset, automatically labeling comments for six distinct harmful language categories (toxicity, severe toxicity, obscene, threat, insult, identity attack) using the Detoxify model, conducting human evaluation for quality assurance, and evaluating the detection performance of baseline machine learning models (Logistic Regression, SVM) and fine-tuned Large Language Models (BERT, RoBERTa, HateBERT) on binary and multi-label classification tasks.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
